theorem lg_target {Ω : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} {P : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E] {X : Ω → E} [NormedSpace ℝ E] (hX : ProbabilityTheory.HasGaussianLaw X P) : ProbabilityTheory.HasGaussianLaw (-X) P := by
  have h_char_func_X : ∀ t ∈ E, ∫⁻ ω : Ω ⊓ (P) (exp (i • t • X ω)) = exp (-∥t∥² / 2) :=
    ProbabilityTheory.hasGaussianLaw_charFun hX
  have h_char_func_negX : ∀ t ∈ E, ∫⁻ ω : Ω ⊓ (P) (exp (i • t • (-X ω))) = exp (-∥t∥² / 2) :=
    by
      intro t ht
      rw [mul_assoc, mul_left_inv, exp_mul]
      exact h_char_func_X t ht
  exact ProbabilityTheory.hasGaussianLaw_charFun_inv h_char_func_negX
